report.status_reasons: The Corridor Agreement, which facilitated grain exports from Orvan, expired on 10 September 2026 without a renewal, as confirmed by official notices from the Realm Trade Ministry and news reports. An initial report of a renewal was corrected and retracted by the source.

event_citations.quote: The Corridor Agreement expired on 10 September 2026.
The agreement expired on 10 September without a renewal.
The agreement was signed on 10 September 2025 and ran for one year.
It expired on 10 September without a replacement.

corrections.note: Raven Wire retracted its report that the corridor agreement was renewed, stating the agreement expired without a signed replacement.
